slices.title: Add OHDER coupling analyzer
slices.description: Add a deterministic analyzer that measures touched runtime layers, import direction risk, coupling hotspots, and cross-layer findings during OHDER architect assessment.
acceptanceCriteria: Same-layer changes produce low coupling risk.
Core importing CLI is reported as a cross-layer coupling finding.
Analyzer output is exposed on architect status.
Coupling findings can affect architecture score.

slices.title: Add OHDER durability validator
slices.description: Detect durability-sensitive runtime changes such as projector, snapshot, event, sequence, policy, and migration touchpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Projector and snapshot touchpoints raise durability risk.
Durability findings are exposed on architect status.
Durability risk can affect architecture score.
Existing slice-close behavior remains compatible.

slices.title: Add OHDER authority analyzer
slices.description: Detect direct governed-state writes and duplicate authority risks outside approved runtime authorities.
acceptanceCriteria: Approved projection and ledger authorities are allowed.
Direct writes to runtime snapshots outside approved authorities are reported.
Authority violations are exposed as OHDER findings.
Clear authority violations can lower SSoT architecture score.

slices.title: Add OHDER complexity and SRP analyzer
slices.description: Measure file complexity, mixed responsibility signals, and SRP risk for changed files.
acceptanceCriteria: Focused files produce low complexity risk.
Large multi-concern files produce SRP warnings.
Complexity findings are exposed on architect status.
Complexity risk can affect architecture score.

slices.title: Add OHDER refactor execution planner
slices.description: Convert refactor targets and analyzer findings into concrete, governed refactor execution plans without auto-applying patches.
acceptanceCriteria: Doc targets produce split-doc-section plans.
Cross-layer coupling targets produce reduce-cross-layer-import plans.
High-risk plans require approval.
Planner output can be embedded in refactor task metadata.

slices.title: Document deep OHDER analyzers
slices.description: Update README and operations docs with the new analyzer responsibilities and operator guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: README explains coupling, durability, authority, complexity, and refactor execution planning.
Runtime architecture docs map analyzers to the OHDER loop.
Operator playbooks explain how to respond to analyzer warnings.
ASK gates pass after documentation updates.
